text: One of the most realistic black holes ever shown in cinema came from a movie.
Christopher Nolan wanted a black hole that wasn't just visually impressive...
Scientists actually worked with the filmmakers to calculate how light would bend around a massive spinning black hole.
Its incredible glowing ring isn't just a visual effect.
Light from behind the black hole bends around it,
allowing you to see parts of the accretion disk that would normally be hidden.
the research behind this visual effect even contributed to scientific studies.
Interstellar didn't just imagine a black hole.
